resale_co.name: Certificate of Compliance (COC), also called Certificate of Occupancy; Pre-Occupancy Inspection for sales
resale_co.issued_by: Zoning Office / Housing Office (Zoning & Housing Official)
requirements: House numbers 5 inches high and visible from the street
GFI protected outlets within 6 feet of a water source and on all exterior outlets
Fire extinguisher mounted in the kitchen
Appliances installed properly and working, no extension cords; exhaust fan over the stove (ductless hood allowed) and anti-tip bracket on the stove
Adequate electric, heating and plumbing service; two separate outlets in each habitable room
Bathroom vented or with a working window
Screened window in each room; all windows working with locks; exterior doors and hardware working
Handrails on steps with more than 3 risers; rails around landings or porches 30 inches or higher
Water heater relief valve piped to within 6 inches of the floor; emergency shut-off at the top of the stairs for a basement heater
Pools over 125 square feet and 3 feet or higher need a fence at least 4 feet high with a self-latching gate
House free of insect infestation
Smoke/CO inspection must pass (separate Bureau of Fire Prevention certificate)
Private well homes must comply with the Private Well Testing Act before sale; homes on a cesspool or privy cannot be sold until it is replaced with an approved system
resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill in the Upper Pittsgrove Township Pre-Occupancy Application, SALES Only (revised 03/30/2026) and mail it with a check payable to Upper Pittsgrove Township to the Township Housing Office, or leave it in the drop box at the Municipal Building, 431 Route 77, Elmer. The Smoke/CO certificate is a separate $25 application to the Bureau of Fire Prevention. Zoning Office hours are Tuesday 10 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.

evidence.quote: UPT ordinance requires a COC (Certificate of Compliance) on residential or commercial rental properties whenever occupants change; therefore, a new COC is also required prior to the sale of a property.

To assure Upper Pittsgrove Township Housing Department that Ordinance 2005-7 is in compliance, the above information must be submitted to this department prior to issuance of the "Certificate of Occupancy".
Zoning Office Hours Tuesday 10 a.m.-11:30 a.m. Zoning Office Address 431 Route 77 Elmer, NJ 08318 Zoning Office Contact (T) 856-358-8500 (F) 856-358-1160 Zoning & Housing Official Tanya Timberman

resale_co.notes: The Township Zoning and Construction page says a new Certificate of Compliance (also called a Certificate of Occupancy) is required before the sale of a property, and posts a Pre-Occupancy Application for sales (revised 03/30/2026): $25 inspection and $25 re-inspection if needed, check payable to Upper Pittsgrove Township, with the CO issued in the buyer's name. The sales form says to mail it to "Upper Pittsgrove Township Housing Office 431 Route 40 Elmer, NJ 08313", while the Township office is at 431 Route 77, Elmer, NJ 08318; confirm the mailing address. No lead time or validity period is published. The Zoning & Housing Official email zoningofficer@upperpittsgrovenj.org was decoded from the page's Cloudflare email protection. Building permits are handled by the Pittsgrove Township Construction Office (Chuck Hughes, Construction Officer). Rentals also need a COC on every change of occupant, a landlord registration and, for homes built before 1979, a lead-safe certificate.

requirements: 10-year sealed battery smoke alarms on every level (or hardwired where required); basement alarm at the bottom of the stairwell at ceiling level
A 10-year sealed smoke alarm in every bedroom (Township rule); hardwired alarms cannot be replaced with battery alarms
Smoke and CO alarms must be less than 10 years old and working
CO alarm in the hallway within 10 feet of all bedrooms
A low-voltage fire alarm system must be tested and certified by an alarm contractor before the inspection; bring the certificate
House numbers at least 4 inches high, contrasting color, permanently fixed and visible from the street
Homes with solar, a generator or battery storage need a permanent printed label (for example "Caution: Multiple Sources of Power") at the main electrical panel and the electric meter
The Township CO checklist still lists a fire extinguisher mounted in the kitchen

fire_cert.notes: Upper Pittsgrove enforces the fire code locally (LEA registry code M). The Township Bureau of Fire Prevention runs its own Certificate of Smoke/Carbon Monoxide Detector Compliance ($25.00, form posted April 2026), and the state fire directory (listed there as Upper Pittsgrove Township 1714) names Fire Official Timothy J O'Donnell at (856) 358-8500 with Upper Pittsgrove Twp for smoke detector compliance; the directory's email for him is cut off, so the Bureau email printed on the Township form (upperpittsgrovefm@outlook.com, also on the Township website) is used. The form header prints the email without the @ sign; page 2 prints it in full. The Bureau form covers smoke alarms, CO alarms and the secondary power source label and does not list a fire extinguisher, matching the 2025 state change (P.L.2025, c.19), but the Township Housing CO checklist still lists a fire extinguisher mounted in the kitchen.

other_items.label: Private well testing
other_items.detail: Under the Private Well Testing Act (N.J.S.A. 58:12A-26), a home on a private well cannot be sold without complying with the Act.

other_items.label: Cesspool or privy
other_items.detail: N.J.A.C. 7:9A-3.16 bars the sale of a property served by a cesspool, privy, outhouse or pit toilet until it is replaced with an approved system.
